questions.q: 4. If E is ranked third, then which one of the following is correct?
options: E gets more marks than C
C gets more marks than E
questions.explain: If E is third, then it is likely that the rankings place A in fourth, as per their score comparisons.

questions.q: 7. Four tests—Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and Biology are to be conducted on four consecutive days, not necessarily in the same order. The Physics test is held before the test which is conducted after Biology. Chemistry is conducted exactly after two tests are held. Which is the last test held?
questions.explain: Given Physics is before Biology and Chemistry is after two tests, Mathematics must be the last test.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 8. 15 students failed in a class of 52. After removing the names of failed students, a merit order list has been prepared in which the position of Ramesh is 22nd from the top. What is his position from the bottom?
questions.explain: Ramesh's position can be calculated as 52 - 15 - 22 + 1 = 16 from the bottom.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 9. In a test, Randhir obtained more marks than the total marks obtained by Kunal and Debu. The total marks obtained by Kunal and Shankar are more than those of Randhir. Sonal obtained more marks than Shankar. Neha obtained more marks than Randhir. Who amongst them obtained highest marks?
questions.explain: Sonal is the only person who can be confirmed to have scored the highest given the conditions.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 12. In a class of 60 students, where the number of girls is twice that of boys, Kamal, a boy, ranked seventeenth from the top. If there are 9 girls ahead of Kamal, the number of boys in rank after him is:
questions.explain: Since there are 20 boys in total, after removing Kamal and those above him, there are 12 boys below him in rank.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 13. Four persons A, B, C and D consisting of two married couples are in a group. Both the women are shorter than their respective husbands. A is the tallest among the four. C is taller than B. D is B's brother. In this context, which one of the following statements is not correct?
options: B is the shortest among the four.
questions.explain: Since both women are shorter than their husbands, it suggests B cannot be chosen as the tallest or vice versa.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 14. If A runs less fast than B, and B runs as fast but not faster than C; then, as compared to A, C runs:
options: Given data is not sufficient to determine
questions.explain: Since C runs at least as fast as B and B is faster than A, it follows that C must be faster than A.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 15. Usha runs faster than Kamala, Priti runs slower than Swati, Swati runs slower than Kamala. Who is the slowest runner?
questions.explain: Since Priti is slower than Swati, and Swati is slower than Kamala, Priti is confirmed to be the slowest.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 16. Which one of the following is possible?

questions.q: 17. What is the number of logically possible orders of all six cousins in terms of increasing age?
questions.explain: Considering the provided order, there are constraints on the ordering, hence only two orders are possible.

questions.q: 18. There are seven persons up on a ladders A, B, C, D, E, F and G (not in that order). A is further up than E but is lower than C. B is in the middle. G is between A and B. E is between B and F. If F is between E and D, the person on the bottom step of the ladder will be
questions.explain: Identifying the relationships, D must be at the bottom based on where E and F fall in the order.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 19. In a row 'A' is in the 11th position from the left and 'B' is in the 10th position from the right. If 'A' and 'B' interchange, then 'A' becomes 18th from the left. How many persons are there in the row other than 'A' and 'B'?
questions.explain: The total number of persons in the row is 11 (from left) + 10 (from right) - 1 (the one position shared by A and B) = 20, leading then to 25 others.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 21. In a class of 45 students, a boy is ranked 20th. When two boys joined, his rank was dropped by one. What is his new rank from the end?
questions.explain: After the addition of boys, his new rank is 21st from the top, thus making him 25th from the bottom.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 22. Gita is prettier than Sita but not as pretty as Rita. Then,
options: Sita is not as pretty as Gita
Rita is not as pretty as Gita
questions.explain: Since Gita is prettier than Sita, it confirms that Sita is less attractive than Gita.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning

questions.q: 24. In a queue, Mr. X is fourteenth from the front and Mr. Y is seventeenth from the end, while Mr. Z is exactly in between Mr. X and Mr. Y. If Mr. X is ahead of Mr. Y and there are 48 persons in the queue, how many persons are then between Mr. X and Mr. Z?
questions.explain: Adding X's rank from the front and Y's from the back (14 + 17 = 31), we can calculate the number of persons between them as 48 - 31 - 1 = 16, meaning 8 persons are in between.
questions.subject: Logical Reasoning
